prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an original creature design sheet for SIGNAL / 47, a grounded cosmic investigation horror game set in New Mexico 1986. Character: Pale, a tall gaunt reactive intruder. Landscape sheet with three coherent full-body views of exactly the same creature: front relaxed A-pose, side profile, rear, plus one large head closeup on the far right. Neutral charcoal gray studio background, feet fully visible, clean separated silhouettes, restrained realistic cinematic creature concept art suitable as first reference for a 3D sculptor. Anatomy: approximately 2.2m tall, narrow ribcage, thin long limbs with plausible joints, slightly hunched shoulders, long four-fingered hands with opposing thumb, long narrow feet, enlarged smooth bald asymmetric pear-shaped cranium tapering toward a tiny jaw. Chalk pale desaturated gray skin with subtle translucency, tendon folds and very fine dusty mottling, no blood, no wounds, no exposed organs, no overt sexual anatomy. Large glossy black almond eyes with a single tiny crisp white pinprick reflection in each, not luminous white eyeballs, no bloom. Tiny recessed nostril slits, closed fine mouth. Quiet intelligent watchful and deeply unsettling, not roaring. Distinctive original feature: shallow diagonal skin fold from outer eye toward jaw and long curved occiput, understated rather than armored. Soft studio light clearly reveals anatomy. No clothing, equipment, spikes, biomechanical tubes, logos, watermarks or lettering. All views must depict the same design and body proportions. This is an original proposal, not a recreation of a named film or game creature.

Use case: stylized-concept. Original SIGNAL / 47 Pale creature movement concept. Use the attached character sheet as the identity reference; keep exactly its pale skin, large bald rear-elongated cranium, tiny jaw, glossy black almond eyes with a single tiny white pinpoint in each, gaunt long-limbed anatomy and hand design. A wide cinematic full-body three-quarter view of this SAME creature moving low on all fours across a dusty wooden farmhouse floor, its shoulders lowered and long elbows flexed, fingers spread bearing weight, folded knees anatomically plausible, head lifted toward the viewer. It should feel alarmingly capable of crawling but not a new species; only two arms and two legs. Whole body and every hand/foot visible and clear for a modeler. Restrained abandoned 1986 New Mexico farmhouse interior, blank plaster walls, open doorway behind; no objects covering anatomy. Soft sidelight and weak flashlight spill reveal pale skin and contact shadows, dark restrained neutral colors, realistic horror production concept painting. Quiet predatory attention, not screaming, no teeth display. No blood, gore, clothing, sexual anatomy, extra limbs, text, labels or watermarks. Preserve identity from reference.

Use case: stylized-concept. Cinematic in-game mood target for SIGNAL / 47, New Mexico 1986. Use attached Pale sheet as identity reference: same tall extremely thin pale creature, large smooth bald rear-elongated head, glossy black almond eyes, tiny jaw. A landscape first-person view from a dusty abandoned farmhouse kitchen through a partly open wooden door into an unlit narrow hall. Pale stands absolutely still several meters away in the doorway at the end of the hall, slightly hunched to fit, its long arms hanging. It is the main focal point but occupies only about one quarter of picture height. The head silhouette and faint cheek/shoulder contours are barely discernible. Exactly TWO very small crisp white catchlights, one pinpoint in each otherwise BLACK eye, are the first thing readable in the darkness. They are tiny reflections, no big glowing white eyeballs, no beams, no bloom, no additional light points. A weak off-camera handheld flashlight grazes dusty floorboards and peeling plaster, enough reflected light to make the creature barely visible. Subtle cool night spill from kitchen window, desaturated amber wood and black shadows. Visible open side passage in foreground suggests a possible retreat. Terrifying anticipation, silence, no attack pose, no gore, no human character or visible weapon, no HUD, text or watermark. Realistic cinematic horror concept painting with disciplined light levels; image must remain readable rather than entirely black. Preserve the original creature design from reference.
